title: Registering a Renter's Challenge to a Car Rental Recharge
content:
A renter who wishes to challenge a recharge raised on a rental booked under the Car Rental Rate Classes has
that challenge registered in their own name against the rental. The challenge stands with the rental desk
as submitted and undecided, and the amount challenged stays on the ledger while it is open; registering it
changes no charge and returns no money on its own.

## When the amount is fixed

The amount a renter may put in dispute is fixed only once the ledger carries the entry for the damage the
rental desk has approved against the rental.

## The handling action

The renter raises this themselves. The tool `raise_recharge_dispute_65c619e1` is unlocked and handed over
to be run by the customer themselves; the desk does not run it on their behalf. One call registers a fresh
damage review against that rental in the renter's name, with the amount the renter is challenging and the
reference of the evidence they are relying on, so the rental desk has the challenge on its list and the
renter can see it open against the rental. One challenge is registered for each decided review reference.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `drive_rental_id` | the internal reference number of the car rental the challenge is raised against | an identifier, read from the rental record returned by the car rental lookup |
| `customer_id` | the traveller reference number of the renter raising the challenge | an identifier, read from the traveller profile returned by the profile lookup |
| `drive_review_id` | the reference number of the rental damage review the desk already decided on this incident | an identifier, read from the rental damage review lookup |
| `evidence_reference` | the reference of the evidence the renter is relying on, taken from what the renter reads out in this conversation | verbatim: copied character for character with the original wording, digits, spacing and punctuation kept, and nothing translated, tidied, shortened or added |
| `disputed_amount_usd` | the amount being challenged | a US dollar amount with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent at the moment it is registered, given as a positive figure and never left empty |

None of the five parameters carries a fixed set of permitted values; each is the value the record, the
renter's own words or the figure gives.

## Return

A confirmation sentence naming the reference number of the challenge registered, the rental it stands
against, the amount challenged in US dollars to 2 decimal places and the evidence reference recorded with
it. A sentence of that shape means the challenge is open with the rental desk; any other reply means nothing
was registered.
